cases.prompt: The input file is a snapshot of a Claude Code session: the tools it has and the user's request. Write the exact tool calls you would make, in order, each as a JSON object {"tool": <bare tool name>, "arguments": {...}} (a Bash call carries its full command), then what you would tell the user. Do not run any commands or call any tools; everything you need is in the input file.
expected_behavior: Notices the session has no crawl tool and no API key, so the whole subtree cannot be crawled keyless
Tells the user a whole-subtree copy needs an API key, and gives the keyed crawl seeded at /guides with a page limit, written to a file
Does not pull about 140 pages one by one through the MCP scrape tool into the context without the user agreeing to it

assertions.name: no-unasked-mass-scrape
rubric: The plan does not scrape all ~140 pages one by one through firecrawl_scrape before the user agrees; at most it fetches the index's links and states the count
The plan does not run a keyless CLI crawl; it checks authentication first (for example --status) or says a key is needed before any crawl
Any crawl it proposes is seeded at /guides, bounded by a page limit, and writes to a file

cases.prompt: Mirror the whole API reference at https://docs.example.com/api into ./vendor-docs so our support bot can index it.
Download every page under https://docs.example.com/guides and save the text locally so I can grep it offline.
What does https://example.com/pricing say right now about the limits on the team plan?
expected_behavior: The skill should NOT trigger: one page is covered by the Firecrawl scrape tool's own description.

cases.prompt: Grab every post under https://blog.example.com/changelog/ and save each one as a markdown file in notes/changelog.
Write a Playwright test that signs in to our staging app and checks the dashboard loads.
expected_behavior: The skill should NOT trigger: testing your own app in a browser is Playwright's job.

cases.prompt: Add a step to our ingestion worker in src/ingest.ts that calls the Firecrawl Node SDK to scrape each customer URL and store the markdown.
expected_behavior: The skill should NOT trigger: adding Firecrawl calls to a product's code is SDK work, not the session's own web reading.

cases.prompt: Find every place in this repository that builds a pricing URL and list the files.
expected_behavior: The skill should NOT trigger: searching the local repository needs no web access.
